results.title: Publishing foundation and release integrity
results.summary: Review FAILED after 3 cycle(s) with 2 blocking finding(s). Headless runs do not commit at the cycle cap; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/ManageArticleRelease.php:143 — Delivery only compares the previous live release and never rechecks that the package revision is still the article's current working version; an approved unscheduled package can be invalidated by a later save, re-approved, and delivered from the stale snapshot despite the spec requiring stale release invalidation and a current-version check inside delivery → Reject approval/delivery for packages whose revision_id is no longer current, or mark all invalidated packages withdrawn/stale, and add a regression for edit-after-approval on an unscheduled release

high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/AdvancePublishingAttempt.php:40 — develop() returns any non-abandoned current_attempt_id, including a completed Published attempt, so post-publication work can reuse the completed attempt/allowance instead of starting a new working attempt as required by the separate live/working model → Only reuse active in-progress attempts; create a new attempt after Published/terminal stages and cover developing a new revision after publication
